title: Maps from finitely presented algebras into essentially smooth algebras factor through smooth algebras
statement: Let $R\to D$ be an essentially smooth homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], $C$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation ($C\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$) and $g:C\to D$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Then there are a smooth $R$-algebra $T$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $C\to T\to D$ whose composite is $g$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07FJ, justification of item (item-eighth-resolve), lines 3062-3074: 'D' is essentially smooth over the local Artinian ring ... Hence D'[t_1,...,t_d] is a filtered colimit of smooth algebras and B (x) ... factors through one of these'; written out as a statement by an agent (D = S^{-1}P is the filtered colimit of the smooth R-algebras P_s, s in S, and a finitely presented algebra map into a filtered colimit factors through a stage)

proof.text: (Presentation of $D$; the smooth algebras $P_f$.) By definition of essential smoothness [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map] there are a smooth $R$-algebra $P$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], a multiplicative subset $S\subseteq P$ and an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $\varphi:D\to S^{-1}P$. For $f\in S$ let $P_f$ be the localization of $P$ at $\{1,f,f^2,\dots\}$, an $R$-algebra through $R\to P\to P_f$. Since $R\to P$ is smooth, $R\to P\to P_f$ is smooth [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-principal-localization]: every $P_f$, $f\in S$, is a smooth $R$-algebra.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07FJ, Ad (item-eighth-resolve), lines 3062-3074 ('D' is essentially smooth ... Hence D'[t_1,...,t_d] is a filtered colimit of smooth ... algebras and B (x) ... factors through one of these')

proof.text: ($S^{-1}P$ is a filtered colimit of the $P_f$ as $R$-algebras.) Preorder $S$ by divisibility ($f\le g$ iff $g=fh$ for some $h\in P$). By [lem-weil-pbc-localization-colimit-principal-localizations] this preorder, regarded as a category $J$, is filtered, $f\mapsto P_f$ with the maps $\rho_{fg}:P_f\to P_g$, $a/f^e\mapsto ah^e/g^e$, is a functor from $J$ to commutative rings, and $(S^{-1}P,(\kappa_f)_{f\in S})$, $\kappa_f(a/f^e)=a/f^e$, is its colimit in the category of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. All these maps are homomorphisms of $R$-algebras: $\rho_{fg}(a/1)=a/1$ and $\kappa_f(a/1)=a/1$ for $a\in P$, so $\rho_{fg}$ and $\kappa_f$ commute with the structure maps from $P$, hence with those from $R$ (which factor through $R\to P$).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00CR (lemma-localization-colimit, line 1243: S^{-1}M = colim_{f in S} M_f, here M = P) and Lemma Tag 00QO (lemma-characterize-finite-presentation, line 31886, (1) implies (3))

proof.text: (Factorization through a stage.) Choose an isomorphism of $R$-algebras $C\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ and replace $C$ by this quotient (transporting $g$ along the isomorphism and back at the end). The map $\varphi\circ g:C\to S^{-1}P$ is a homomorphism of $R$-algebras into the filtered colimit of Step 2, whose stages $P_f$, transition maps $\rho_{fg}$ and coprojections $\kappa_f$ are $R$-algebras and $R$-algebra maps. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-algebra-factors-filtered-colimit] there are $f\in S$ and a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $g':C\to P_f$ with $\kappa_f\circ g'=\varphi\circ g$ (this is Stacks, Algebra, Lemma 00QO, (1) implies (3)).

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00CR (lemma-localization-colimit, line 1243: S^{-1}M = colim_{f in S} M_f, here M = P) and Lemma Tag 00QO (lemma-characterize-finite-presentation, line 31886, (1) implies (3))

proof.text: (Conclusion.) Put $T=P_f$, smooth over $R$ by Step 1, with the $R$-algebra maps $g':C\to T$ and $\varphi^{-1}\circ\kappa_f:T\to D$. Then $(\varphi^{-1}\circ\kappa_f)\circ g'=\varphi^{-1}\circ\varphi\circ g=g$, so $g$ factors as $C\to T\to D$ with $T$ a smooth $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].
